name: Jaroslav Bžoch - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Agreement between the European Union and the Kingdom of Norway on the transfer of passenger name record (PNR) data to prevent, detect, investigate and prosecute terrorist offences and serious crime
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to a new deal between the European Union and Norway on sharing passenger name record data. This is information airlines collect when people book and check in for flights. Under the deal, airlines can pass this data to Norway and Norway can pass it to European Union countries. The aim is to help catch terrorists and serious criminals, since Norway and the European Union share an open travel area without internal border checks.

- Airlines can now send flight passenger data between Norway and European Union countries.
- It affects air passengers flying between Norway and the European Union, and police in both places.
- Norway must now formally conclude the agreement; Parliament has given its consent.
